scope_label: Kingdom of Nepal and Nepal honours, decorations and medals

sources.source_name: MedalBook — complete Nepal orders and medals catalogue
sources.content_coverage: Both public result pages and all 114 discovered order, medal and decoration object pages
sources.coverage_result: 114/114 award object pages processed without failures; 64/64 exposed images cached. Eighteen pictured grade/type rows in nine families and 30 selected source views were normalized; 96 pages remain in the unpictured appendix. One reverse-only Trishakti V Class page was withheld from the formal catalogue.

sources.source_name: ODM / medals.org.uk — recursively completed Nepal directory
sources.content_coverage: Every master-list award page and all reachable type subpages, 50 pages total
sources.coverage_result: 50/50 recursively discovered pages and 50/50 exposed files processed without failures. Twenty-two pictured grade/type rows in 12 represented families and 30 source views were normalized; nine duplicate rows were merged as 11 alternate views into matching MedalBook variants. Ribbon-only files were excluded.
